image_description: A large, greyish-green common iguana resting on the ground amidst dry leaves and green foliage. The iguana is viewed from the side, displaying its prominent dorsal crest, large subtympanic shield, and muscular limbs. The lighting suggests a natural outdoor environment with dappled sunlight.
